note: Party-ledger golden totals. Labels are sample relabellings; every quantity, rate, date and boolean is byte-identical to the verified source workbook. Numbers were computed with the engine rules (round0 per row for quarry payable; aggregate rounding per rate group for receivable, rent and profit) and cross-asserted in the extractor against every workbook cell that is internally consistent. Unit tests MUST reproduce these exactly.
corrections: The source workbook's SUMMARY reads fixed cells (G18/G36) from every party sheet; one sheet's layout is 4 rows shorter, so its summary picked up an owner-rent cell and a profit cell instead of the real totals. The per-party values here are the correct ones.
One sheet's profit TOTAL sums G39:G41 and silently drops the last share line; the golden profit includes every share.

One sheet's Amount column contains two hand-typed values that contradict qty x rate (one stale after a qty edit, one missing). quarryPayable here is engine-derived from qty x rate for every row, matching the sheet's own Calc Amount column.
